brief.text: Borr Drilling (BORR) generated the largest cluster total at $57,144,458 across three insiders, topping Bluerock Private Real Estate Fund (BPRE) at $37,168,650 as closed-end funds formed a recurring theme alongside CRAFX and NXG. Fuller H B Co (FUL) saw the broadest participation with eight insiders making purchases, though their filings combined for a modest $1,123,318. Rapport Therapeutics (RAPP) stands out across both lists, with a single director, James Healy, responsible for $20,359,080 of the company's $22,023,905 total across seven buying insiders.
